messages.website.shell.tagline: An old world. A new adventure.
messages.website.shell.localSave: Play without an account. Your progress stays in this browser.
messages.website.shell.ogImage: A BackMir Wizard fighting in Lava Hell
messages.website.shell.homeTitle: Solo Loot RPG for Windows and Mac Browsers
messages.website.shell.homeDescription: Explore a classic Mir-style solo RPG in your browser. Choose Warrior, Wizard or Taoist, discover rare gear and challenge powerful bosses. No account or installation required; progress is saved locally.
messages.website.shell.aboutDescription: Learn what is available in BackMir, how local saves work and what is planned next.
messages.website.shell.aboutLead: The official BackMir site: play without an account and explore the game guide.
messages.website.shell.availableText: Play without signing up and save your progress in this browser. Browse guides, quests, maps, NPCs, skills and recipes.
messages.website.shell.plansText: Player comments and suggestions are planned for a later update. Account registration, online submissions and paid memberships are not available yet.
messages.website.shell.localText: Characters are saved in this browser. Guest saves have no cloud backup: clearing site data may erase your progress. Saves do not automatically transfer between devices, browsers or website addresses.
messages.website.shell.analyticsText: We use Google Analytics 4 to count page visits and play-button clicks so we can improve the site. Analytics uses cookies and browser visit data. We do not send character names, save data or search queries, and advertising personalization is disabled.
messages.website.shell.updatesText: Guide articles are reviewed for the current release, and reference pages are generated from the same game data. This guide describes the current browser edition; requirements and messages shown in the game still apply.
